decision.rationale: TXN-007998 (1583 EUR cents, HARBOUR MARKET, MER-000064) is on card CRD-000017. It was posted on 2026-07-29 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 91 days later. That is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008198, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified, response APPROVED and no fraud flag. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, this means the card and PIN were both present, so the payment is treated as made by the cardholder. The card has four earlier approved purchases at the same merchant before the disputed one: TXN-007997, TXN-000577, TXN-000560 and TXN-007996, from 2026-05-23 to 2026-07-02. These support the decline. The cardholder says they do not recognise the payment and still have the card. That claim does not outweigh a chip transaction with the PIN verified.

proposed_actions.reason: The 15.83 EUR payment to HARBOUR MARKET on 2026-07-28 was made with your card's chip and the correct PIN, and nothing flagged it as fraud. This means the card and PIN were both present when it was made. Your card also shows earlier purchases at the same merchant. We are therefore treating the payment as made by you and closing the dispute.
